newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bund futures get late lift from ECI report.
newsitem.headline: Bund futures get late lift from ECI report.

text.p: Bund futures surged late in the day along with the rest of the globe's debt markets as the U.S. employment cost index showed only faint inflationary pressures.

Analysts, however, said the report did not change the Bund market's fundamental outlook and that the futures contract will remain in the same broad ranges seen since early December -- 100.00 to 102.00.
At 1454, the DTB Bund futures contract was up 25 basis points at 101.39 after trading as low as 100.74 before the ECI report was released.
"All the market has done today is get back to the middle of its recent range," said Stuart Trow, analyst at Norinchukin International Plc. "We saw a correction in a broader range."
As often happens with Treasury-driven rallies, the U.S. market outperformed Bunds on the day, pushing the Bund/T-note spread to 87 basis points from 96 basis points at the prior close.
Analysts said the government's sale of 9.8 billion marks of the 10-year New Year's Bond further hurt the spread to Treasuries as the additional Bund supply hit the market.

Traders said they now expect Bunds to trade in a range between 101.50, near today's high, and 100.75, near the low, until next Thursday when Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan testifies to the U.S. Senate Finance committee from 1500 GMT.
Several Bundesbank council members spoke on Tuesday including Franz-Christoph Zeitler and Edgar Meister, but they for the most part did not address Germany's interest rate outlook.
Bunds, which had been rallying since January 7 when the contract stood at 99.54, tumbled on Friday when German inflation reports dashed hopes for lower interest rates.
"The German market was sucker-punched by weak economic data earlier in the winter," one analyst said. "Things are starting to correct themselves now."
The German yield curve flattened one basis point on the day to 233 basis points. The short-end of the curve narrowed the most, shrinking three basis points to 130 basis poitns.
